summary: NeoGenomics, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 15, 2026, to disclose the commencement of a proposed offering of $275 million aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2032, with an additional option for initial purchasers to buy up to $41.25 million. The notes are being offered privately to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A, are senior unsecured obligations, mature July 1, 2032, and pay semi-annual interest. Settlements of conversions will be in cash, stock, or a combination. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation; no change of control, buyout, or strategic event is involved.
